comment: A right click on a fog-of-war ghost (RightClickAction, order 133, and ReissueRightClick 0x47f530): a Marine next to a computer's Supply Depot walks east until the depot is out of sight; once the tiles are reset (every 100 steps) the depot leaves a ghost. The Marine is right-clicked on the ghost: it walks back, and when the depot's tile is in view again the click is resolved against the depot (Attack).
